scope: Retrospective saved-evidence calibration; criteria are not claimed to precede the original experiments.
reference_rule: FAIL if any independent required reference fails; PASS only if every independent required reference passes; otherwise UNKNOWN. Blocked/error/missing tests remain unknown, never scientific failures.
adoption_rule: Every criterion must pass within each declared prior/runtime cohort; missing evidence blocks adoption. Zero training is authorized by this calibration.
false_accept_denominator: All paired lineages with an independent FAIL reference (false_accept + true_reject).
false_reject_denominator: All paired lineages with an independent PASS reference (false_reject + true_accept).
cost_rule: Both complete task-cost vectors required; compare the maximum observed smoke sum and maximum per-lineage smoke/reference ratio, within each exact prior/runtime cohort. Unknown costs never count as zero.
